name: Primal Containment
summary:
Primal Containment is a multiplayer VR horror experience set within a secret underground containment facility overrun by dangerous anomalies.

Work together with other players to survive, and navigate a complex network of containment chambers, tunnels, and research sectors while avoiding deadly threats that lurk throughout the facility.

Features:

• Fast-paced VR locomotion and movement
• Multiplayer gameplay with friends and other players
• Encounter terrifying anomalies and hostile entities
• Explore con
